questions.question: In 1889, __________ established the Mukti Mission, a refuge for young widows who had been deserted and abused by their families.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandita Ramabai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandita Ramabai (1858-1922)**

 
 
• **Pandita Ramabai** was born in the **Canara district** of the Madras Presidency (now in Karnataka) on **April 23, 1858**.
 
• In order to better the lives of women, particularly child widows, Ramabai pushed girls' education and founded the **Arya Mahila Samaj in Pune in 1881**.
 
• She founded the **Mukti Mission**, a refuge for young widows who had been abandoned and mistreated by their families, **in Pune in 1889**.
 
• She also founded **Sharda Sadan**, which offered **shelter, healthcare, education, and vocational training** to widows, orphans, and those with visual impairments.
 
• Because of her **intellectual Sanskrit expertise**, she is the first woman to be given the title **Pandita**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• She died on **5 April 1922**.
 
• In **1919, she receives the Kaisar-i-hind medal** for her volunteer work in the community.
 
• Ramabai is honoured with a** "feast day" on the Episcopal Church's liturgical calendar (USA)**.
 
• She also authored a number of books that depicted the **difficult lives of women, including child widows and child brides**.
 
• Ramabai had learned **18000 Puranas verses **by the time she was 12 years old in addition to Sanskrit.
 
• She studied Bengali, Hindi, Kanarese, and Marathi.
 
• Her mother was **Lakshmibai**, and her father, **Anant Shastri**, was an educated Brahmin.

questions.question: If the roots of the equation 2x² - 3x + a = 0 are in the ratio 1 : 2, then find the value of a.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Roots of the equation 2x2 - 3x + a = 0 are in the ratio 1 : 2

**Concept used:**

If equation = ax² + bx + c then 

Sum of roots = -b/a

Product of roots = c/a

**Calculations:**

Let the roots be α and 2α 

According to the question,

⇒ α + 2α = -(-3)/2 = 3/2

⇒ 3α = 3/2

⇒ α = 1/2

And, α × 2α = a/2

⇒ 2α² = a/2

⇒ a = 4α2 

⇒ a = 4(1/4) = 1

**∴ The value of a is 1.**

questions.question: IANA oversees the allocation of IP address to organisations and individuals. What is the full form of IANA?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Internet Assigned Numbers Authority**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) **

 
 
• The **IANA** is a standards body that manages **media types, global IP address allocation, root zone management in the Domain Name System (DNS), autonomous system number assignment**, and other Internet Protocol-related numbers and symbols.
 
• It is **currently carried out by** **ICANN**, a nonprofit private American business **founded in 1998** largely for this purpose under a contract with the **United States Department of Commerce**.
 
• From **1998 until 2016**, IANA was run by ICANN directly before being handed to **Public Technical Identifiers (PTI), an ICANN subsidiary that still manages IANA today**.
 
• Before that, **Jon Postel oversaw IANA primarily at the University of Southern California's (USC) Information Sciences Institute (ISI)**, located in Marina Del Rey (Los Angeles), as part of a deal the USC/ISI had with the US Department of Defense.
 
• IANA performs its duty in close coordination with the **RFC Editorial team and the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Regional Internet Registries (RIRs)** receive IP address block allocations from IANA.
 
• **Addresses are distributed** by each RIR for a certain region of the globe.
 
• The **Number Resource Organization was established by the RIRs** collectively as a body to represent their shared interests and guarantee that global policy statements are coordinated.
 
• **IANA facilitates the registration of protocols** and manages protocol registries **in tables of parameters and protocols**.
 
• There were more than** 2,800 registrations and sub registries as of 2015**.
 
• IANA is responsible for maintaining the **IETF RFC5646-defined IANA Language Subtag Registry**.

questions.question: Team India scored runs in the first 30 overs in an ODI match at an average of 5.6 runs per over. What is the required runs per over in the remaining 20 overs at which the team has to score to meet a total target of 320?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Run rate (R1) for first 30 overs = 5.6 runs per over

Total target (T) = 320 runs

Total number of overs = 50

**FORMULA USED:**

Total runs = Run rate × no. of overs

**Calculations:**

For first 30 overs,

Total runs (T1) = R1 x no. of overs

⇒ 5.6 × 30 = 168 runs

For next 20 overs,

Total runs (T2) = T - T1

⇒ 320 - 168 = 152 runs

Now Run rate (R2) = T2 / no. of overs 

⇒ 152 / 20 = 7.6 runs per over.

**∴ Team India needs run rate of 7.6 runs per over to achieve the target of 320 runs.**

questions.question: If 21st March 2021 was a Sunday, then what will be the day on 12th January 2022?

• Since, it was Sunday on 21st March 2021, every 7th day from 21st March will be a Sunday.
 
• Thus, no. of odd days from 21st March 2021 to 12th January 2022 = 297/7 = **3**
 
• Now, 21st March 2021 + 3 odd days = 12th January 2022 ( Wednesday)
 
• Thus, 12th January 2022 will be **Wednesday**.

Hence, "option 1" is the correct answer.

 Average Revenue

 Marginal revenue
 It is the increase in revenue that results from the sale of one additional unit of output. While marginal revenue can remain constant over a certain level of output, it follows from the law of diminishing returns and will eventually slow down as the output level increases.

questions.question: In ΔABC, DE || BC, intersecting AB at D and AC at E. AD : BD :: 2 : 3 and the area of trapezium BDEC is 63 cm². What is the area of ΔADE?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In ΔABC, DE || BC, where D and E are points on AB and AC respectively.

AD : BD = 2 : 3

Area of trapezium BDEC = 63 cm²

**Formula used:**

Area of similar triangles = Square of the corresponding sides

Area(ΔADE)/Area(ΔABC) = (AD)²/(AB)²

**Concept used:**

If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle, then the two triangles are similar.

AD : AB = DE : BC = AE : AC

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/157a84a222dee33d601337b2a04653267317227f912b5e3a718ebbc8ee1d7865.png] 

In ΔABC,

⇒ DE || BC

⇒ ∠A is common

⇒ ∠ADE = ∠ABC and ∠AED = ∠ACB (Alternate interior angles)

⇒ ΔADE ~ ΔABC

Now,

⇒ AD : BD = 2 : 3

⇒ AD : AB = 2 : (2 + 3)

⇒ AD : AB = 2 : 5

⇒ Area(ΔADE)/Area(ΔABC) = (AD)²/(AB)²

⇒ Area(ΔADE)/Area(ΔABC) = (2/5)²

⇒ Area(ΔADE)/Area(ΔABC) = 4/25

Let the area of ΔADE = x cm².

⇒ Area of ΔABC = 25x/4

Area of trapezium BDEC = Area(ΔABC) − Area(ΔADE)

⇒ 63 = 25x/4 − x

⇒ 63 = (25x − 4x)/4

⇒ 63 = 21x/4

⇒ x = (63 × 4)/21

⇒ x = 12 cm²

**∴ The area of ΔADE is 12 cm².**

questions.question: All of the following plants have fibrous roots EXCEPT _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Beetroot**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fibrous Root -**

 
 
• In many plants, after the germination of the seed, the radicle's growth ceases, and roots, known as **fibrous roots, start to form from the radicle's base**. 
 
• The **fibrous root** is another type of root system in which **there is no primary root and the root emerges from the stem as thin, somewhat branched roots**.
 
• Many **monocotyledonous plants**, including ferns, and other plants, have fibrous roots.
 
• Because there are **adventitious roots present**, the fibrous root system is also referred to as an **adventitious root system**.
 
• Fibrous roots are regarded as **surface feeders** because they **do not go deeply into the soil**; instead, t**hey consume the top layer of soil and organic matter for food**.
 
• Plants including** grass, wheat, rice, maize, rosemary, coconut,** and others have fibrous roots.
 
• **Beetroot **is an example of **tap root system**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• One of the two fundamental root systems is the **taproot**, in which the **primary root releases branches of secondary and tertiary roots** that develop downward as the **primary root tapers near the end**.
 
• Examples of plants having taproot system: **carrot, mustard, radish, turnip, beetroot, etc**.
 
• **Other characteristics of fibrous root:**
 
 
• Fibrous roots, in contrast to tap roots, **lack a primary root and are not divided into secondary and tertiary roots**.
 
• This roots are **unable to serve as an organ for storing food**.
 
• When the plant is fully grown, the fibrous root emerges from the **ground as a mat**.
 
• It is thought to be essential for the **prevention of soil erosion** because they hold the surface soil securely and are more fastened to the soil's surface.
